summary: ACCEPT. The marker census -- a read-only report that collapses eleven board rows into one run. WHAT IT ENFORCES: every line names the population that could have produced the marker; a zero denominator reads UNEXERCISED, never PASS; COULD_NOT_TELL never decays; partial coverage prints its rate inline. ⭐ STRICTER THAN I ASKED AND I WANT IT KEPT: the fired-and-clean case is reported OBSERVED, not PASS, so 'it fired therefore it is fine' is not expressible in the vocabulary. ROUND 1 FOUND A REAL HOLE AND I BLOCKED ON IT. Executed mutation against the first head: deleting the `UNEXERCISED if attempted == 0` branch so a zero denominator yields OBSERVED left ALL 17 TESTS PASSING -- the single most important invariant of the report was unpinned. The near-miss was instructive: test_w5_zero_is_readable_only_with_event_row_denominator SOUNDS like it covers this and dies under a COULD_NOT_TELL mutant, but it pins that the DENOMINATOR IS PRINTED, not that ZERO YIELDS UNEXERCISED. Label pinned, verdict unpinned. A report built to catch 'absence reads as safety' had that exact hole in its own coverage. ROUND 2 CLOSES IT, AND I VERIFIED IT THE HARD WAY. Codex reported a parametrized controlled pair over all 12 UNEXERCISED sites, but their M1 replay only re-tested the single site I had already named, which cannot distinguish 'all 12 covered' from 'the one you found covered'. So I mutated FIVE SITES, FOUR OF WHICH I HAD NEVER TOUCHED, against a 31-test baseline: line 427 opportunities==0 -> 1 failed; line 529 hold_started==0 -> 1 failed; line 547 unbacked==0 -> 1 failed; line 580 followups==0 -> 1 failed; line 673 complete==0 -> 3 FAILED. Restore hash-verified byte-identical at b24bcb0443d33643. The pair genuinely reaches the sites; it is not W5-shaped. ⭐ LINE 673 KILLING THREE TESTS IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS: that is the boot-gate branch where restoration_complete=0 must read NEVER REACHED rather than NEVER FAILED, and it is the reading Monday's go/no-go depends on. It is now the most defended line in the file, which is correct. THE FIRST REHEARSAL ALREADY PAID FOR THE BUILD -- it produced readable distinctions rather than a wall of green: W2 identity FAIL with 22 queued / 20 submitted / 3 chain errors; boot gates 2-3 correctly labelled UNEXERCISED FALSE ZEROS (never reached, not never-failed); DB3 0/0 explicitly EXPECTED_ZERO; #832 COULD_NOT_TELL with exact_path_denominator=absent_by_instrumentation. ⛔ AND IT CORRECTED MY OWN TRIAGE: I had marked W2 RETIRE as a never-fires watch. It fires, it fails, and two intents were queued and never submitted. My verdict was wrong and the census is what caught it -- boarded separately under codex-2, correctly kept OUT of this PR so the reporter stays read-only and separate from its findings. #832 is recorded as PERMANENTLY COULD_NOT_TELL under current instrumentation: direct attempts have no exact durable denominator and terminal targets are only an upper bound, so this needs new instrumentation, not another query. That distinction is printed on the line, which is the right place for it. NOT MEASURED: I mutated 5 of the 12 UNEXERCISED sites, not all 12 -- the remaining 7 are covered by the same parametrization and I am accepting them on that structural basis, not on individual execution. No full-suite run by me; codex reports 2,915 passed with 14 skipped. The live Friday rehearsal is read-only and I did not re-run it. ⛔ DEPLOY: ops-only, NOT sync-only eligible, explicit copy required, no service restart. It is read-only by construction. PATCH IDENTITY: I recomputed git patch-id --stable myself and got 9de3138022603be92ba90ac2a8136452eeff6c44.
